Q: Django Allauth login/signup fails with SMTPAuthenticationError (535) in production A:

Everything looks good so I'm thinking this is probably an issue with your host. Since you didn't have any issues in development, what email host did you use in dev? Can you try with another SMTP client?

Also confirm from your host provider if the email host is actually:

EMAIL_HOST = 'mail.agrotekpluss.com'
